svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four. Cut 1,050 mm, square, from 38.1 x 1.47 mm tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr inside and out; the inside edge must not cut the cable.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe a straight line along the tube: the button line (+Y).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back end, sections 1 to 3: drill 8.5 mm on the button line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 mm from the end. This takes the next section's button.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back end, section 4: no button hole; the tail cap pins go in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4.0 mm holes top and bottom, 20 mm from the end (step 2).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front end: the coupler pin holes, 4.0 mm top and bottom 30 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the end, are drilled through with the coupler fitted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Depth marks every 100 mm from the tip, section number at each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end, paint marker under clear heat-shrink.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the next coupler slides in by hand with no rock.
